key_tensions: SPEC vs CONVENTION (bunker setup): spec Design Decision #8 + AC-3P-FILE-4 say copy three-party.spec.ts STATIC bunker setup (E2E_BUNKER_*_URL). But the 2-party PROPERTY spec deliberately uses spawnSpecBunker per-spec fresh bunkers to avoid KeyPackage accumulation across the many property iterations. A property test runs ~15x10 commands; static shared bunkers risk reintroducing the KP-accumulation flakiness spawnSpecBunker was built to prevent. The architect should weigh this; if static bunkers prove flaky in S7 wall-clock validation, switching to spawnSpecBunker(x3) is the known mitigation. AC-3P-FILE-4 names the static constants as the literal requirement; honoring the spec while watching for flakiness in S7 is the default posture.
auth-helper-c.authenticateAsBunkerC lacks slot-pin + hook-wait; route C through two-party.ts authenticate(page, E2E_BUNKER_C_URL) for parity with A/B.
